changelog:
v0.10.11 - Your Mac first, faster pairs

Use your Mac yourself, first: a Mac serving with --local-endpoint, including the desktop app's "Alongside the network", pauses Darkbloom while you use its local API and takes Darkbloom requests again 2 minutes after your last one. To share the Mac as before, set me_first = false under [local] in ~/.config/darkbloom/provider.toml and run darkbloom restart. Each Mac has one local port and one key; Macs updated from 0.10.10 keep port 8000.
